input_manifest.config_id_semantics: zero-based saved-configuration ordinal; trajectory is read from the bound manifest

holdout_policy: IDs 140-199 are reserved jointly for Pion/Optimize and possible Wilson analysis. This Wilson protocol does not authorize measuring or reading them.
match_assumption: rho=alpha/4 matches the leading weak-field linearized update only; it does not certify equal nonperturbative smoothing radius.
normalization: APE uses alpha/4 over four spatial staples and bidirectional polar projection. Stout uses rho per staple and exp(iQ)U. Temporal links are unchanged.

cost_diagnostics.primary_comparison: same configurations, same Wilson-loop observables, paired block-bootstrap risk differences; plot risk versus measured per-kernel and total wall time
cost_diagnostics.claim_limit: Per-configuration total_seconds includes host read/hash, device transfer, all candidate kernel calls, and all loop contractions, but excludes compressed prefix writes and receipt/plot generation. Report full job walltime separately. Do not label a winner as matched-cost unless the same wall-time budget and resulting configuration counts are explicitly compared. Include block-length sensitivity at 1, 2, 5, 10, and 20 saved configurations.

validation_limit: D IDs 120-139 provide only 20 configurations (four nominal length-5 blocks). Treat this as an internal confirmation pilot; if the paired interval is too wide, report INCONCLUSIVE and do not consume shared IDs 140-199 without a joint unlock.
input_integrity: Before each NERSC file is transferred to the GPU, verify its raw-file SHA-256 against the HMC manifest and record the manifest trajectory. The production receipt must preserve per-configuration checksum, residual/validity, loop hash, and failure reason; the current preflight specification alone is not a measurement receipt.
preflight: Copy the bound HMC manifest and raw files into the isolated Kunshan run tree, retaining the manifest hash.
Run measurement preflight and confirm the selected ID ranges, exact raw-file hashes, geometry, beta, periodic boundary, NERSC checksum status, and code hashes.
Run CPU kernel diagnostics and a tiny GPU smoke on the run host before measuring D development IDs 0-99.
Do not start validation IDs 120-139 unless the development reference gate passes; the measurement CLI rejects IDs outside the authorized split list.
supersedes: No historical result is rewritten. protocol_v4 remains the archived S16T16B design; this is a new D-chain confirmation plan.
